answer: karst draws one random cut each epoch and folds aliases whose attestations enter through the same hollow. A head counts only by crossing that cut on an edge-disjoint hollow; one principal’s kth live head must use a kth unused crossing and lock k jade there while it stays live. Head one pays 1 jade; ten heads need ten disjoint crossings and keep 1+…+10=55 jade locked, so one rented bridge cannot be split into a crowd.
